program:
alphabet a b c d

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
is_c = symbol c
is_d = symbol d
h1_1 = rightmost(is_a@i & !is_b@i & !is_c@i & !is_d@i | !is_b@i & !is_a@j, !is_c@i & !is_a@j & !is_d@j | !is_b@i & !is_d@i & !is_a@j & !is_c@j)
h1_2 = leftmost(is_a@i & !is_d@i & !is_a@j & is_b@j & !is_d@j | !is_b@i & !is_a@j, true)
accept = !is_bos & is_a & !is_b & !is_d & !h1_1 | !h1_1 & h1_2

output accept
